protocol: ARM A of docs/14 (D93). 50 claims sampled seed-17 from the 286 live rows present after the 5 main shards (before the in_5 gap shard), graded vs FULL abstracts BEFORE any scoring; labels frozen at write time. Threshold IDENTICAL to D92/arxivai50 — the instrument is unchanged so the arms stay comparable: (a) asserts what the abstract does not; (b) drops a condition/qualifier that changes truth conditions; (c) turns on a method named nowhere in the statement AND carries no paper frame. NOT defects: missing attribution frame where the artifact is named, grammar, kind-field mislabels.
baseline_caveat: Arm 0 comparator is the D92 arxivai50 audit (0.82 [0.69-0.90]), which sampled the same extraction PROCESS over the full 400-paper slice rather than these 100 papers specifically. Process-level comparison, not paired-sample.
